fields.proposed_value: Scope session with the VP of Admissions and the CIO. Scope agreed: 120 users across admissions, marketing and management, with Campus One, Mailwave and WhatsApp integrations, live by May 2027, with a budget of USD 110,000-130,000 a year. Student data must stay in Brazil. Lumen asked for a proposal, due 13 Nov, with a review on 17 Nov.

evidence.quote: So the scope is clear for us
